output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the sender has enough balance to transfer the specified amount. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has enough balance to transfer the specified amount from the specified address. This could allow a user to transfer more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.

The approveAndCall function does not check if the sender has enough balance to approve the specified amount for the specified spender. This could allow a user to approve more tokens than they have, potentially leading to loss of funds.
